source_character_encoding: UTF-8 JSON (the Content-Type header declares application/json;charset=UTF-8)
fetch_recipe: curl -s -o FILE 'https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/api/meeting?issueID=113405254X00219951002&recordPacking=json' with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding; hash the bytes as received.
provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (part A): First download 2026-09-25 12:11:43Z-12:12:26Z (plain, identity); re-downloaded 12:49:47Z (plain) and 12:49:47Z (with a cache-busting &cb= query), each with the same byte count and SHA-256. The part A check downloaded it again at 12:58Z-12:59Z and 13:40Z-13:42Z on 25 September 2026 (the Diet API responses also with a cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 14:16:16Z and 14:52:45Z, 36 minutes apart, and at 14:57:10Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 本会議 第2号 (1995-10-02), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/113405254X00219951002. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office.

visual_review.method: Machine-readable minute text read in full for the cited speeches and the surrounding questions; the printed page images were not viewed.

rows.text: In the House of Representatives plenary on 2 October 1995, 橋本龍太郎 (printed ○国務大臣（橋本龍太郎君）), Minister of International Trade and Industry, said he would do his utmost 'as president of the Liberal Democratic Party and as a member of the cabinet' (自由民主党の総裁として、また閣僚の一員として).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
